dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For natural numbers b, p, and r, this is the type of a complete run-data package constructed by D028, containing dimensions, choices, matrices, vectors, computed quantities, error functions, and all stated structural, execution, residual, and error-bound assumptions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem quantifies over an arbitrary inhabitant run of this package; all named data and hypotheses used by the target are projections from run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The seventh field of run: a real square matrix A of dimension n = p b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A is the original coefficient matrix in the perturbed equation and matrix-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The eleventh field of run: a function L(u,epsilon) returning an n by n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: L is the computed lower factor used in both combined errors, the solve scale, and the bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twelfth field of run: a function U(u,epsilon) returning an n by n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: U is the computed upper factor used in both combined errors, the solve scale, and the bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The eighteenth field of run: the factorization matrix error as a function of u and epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the leading term in the explicitly defined total matrix perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nineteenth field of run: a real-valued factorization remainder function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target reasserts its asymptotic property, requires it to be nonnegative for admissible parameters, and adds it to the matrix-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-fourth field of run: the lower-solve matrix error as a function of u and epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes lowerError times U and lowerError times upperError to the total matrix perturbation, and contributes lowerError times upperRhsError to the total right-hand-side perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-sixth field of run: the lower-solve right-hand-side error vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first term of the combined right-hand-side perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sixth field of run: one of the two recompression choices represented by LocalDef029.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the threshold choice, it determines the coefficient xi in the matrix-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth field of run: one of the two threshold choices represented by LocalDef030.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the recompression choice, it determines xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-fifth field of run: the upper-solve matrix error as a function of u and epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes L times upperError and lowerError times upperError to the total matrix perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The twenty-seventh field of run: the upper-solve right-hand-side error vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes L times upperRhsError and lowerError times upperRhsError to the combined right-hand-side perturbation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The eighth field of run: the original right-hand-side vector v in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the exact perturbed system and the right-hand-side error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fourteenth field of run: the computed solution vector xHat(u,epsilon) in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It solves the asserted perturbed system and enters the solve scale.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef015(n) is the type of n by n real matrices, represented as functions Fin n to Fin n to Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes every matrix in the target to be square of dimension n = p b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef016(n) is the type of real vectors indexed by Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes all vectors in the target to have dimension n = p b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Admissibility of u and epsilon for a real c means 0 < u, 0 < epsilon, u < epsilon, and 3 c u < 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The perturbed equation, nonnegativity assertions, and norm bounds are required only for admissible u and epsilon.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines c = b + 2 r sqrt(r) + p, with natural numbers coerced to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This c determines admissibility and the gamma factor gamma_{3c}(u) in the final matrix bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines xi by a two-by-two case split. For recompression constructor D040, xi is 1 with threshold constructor D043 and p with D042. For recompression constructor D039, xi is p with D043 and p^2/sqrt(6) with D042.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The term xi epsilon multiplies the norm of A in the final matrix perturbation bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices E0, EL, EU, L, and U, it returns E0 + EL U + L EU + EL EU.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact definition imposed on the existential matrixError function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors fL and fU and matrices L and EL, it returns fL + L fU + EL fU.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact definition imposed on the existential rhsError function.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the Frobenius norm: ||A||_F = sqrt(sum_i sum_j A_ij^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every matrix norm in the target and its auxiliary definitions is specifically the Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines gamma_k(u) = k u/(1-k u), using real division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target uses gamma_p(u) and gamma_{3c}(u); run assumptions also use related gamma factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: A remainder R satisfies this property when there are C >= 0 and delta > 0 such that |R(u,epsilon)| <= C u epsilon whenever 0 < u < epsilon, both u and epsilon are at most delta, and epsilon > 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target requires this explicit local O(u epsilon) property of the fixed factorRemainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Relative to a scale S, a remainder R satisfies this property when there are C >= 0 and delta > 0 such that |R(u,epsilon)| <= C u^2 S(u,epsilon) whenever 0 < u < epsilon, u and epsilon are at most delta, and S(u,epsilon) >= 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential rhsRemainder must have this explicit local O(u^2 solveScale) property.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is ordinary matrix-vector multiplication: (A x)_i = sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact perturbed linear system and appears in the definitions of combined solve errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the Euclidean vector norm: ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all vector norms and the solution-dependent solve scale.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructor builds run from 0 < b, 0 < p, r <= b; an algorithm, threshold, and recompression choice; an invertible n by n matrix A and vector v; approximation Atilde, factors L and U, intermediate yHat and solution xHat; admissible-parameter evidence for thresholding, common minimal block rank r, and the chosen factorization execution model; a factor error E0 and remainder rhoA satisfying A + E0 = L U, ||E0||_F <= (xi epsilon + gamma_p(u))||A||_F + gamma_c(u)||L||_F||U||_F + rhoA, rhoA >= 0, and rhoA = O(u epsilon); lower and upper matrix and right-hand-side errors satisfying (L+EL)yHat = v+fL and (U+EU)xHat = yHat+fU; solve-execution evidence; and bounds ||EL||_F <= gamma_d(u)||L||_F, ||EU||_F <= gamma_d(u)||U||_F, ||fL||_2 <= gamma_p(u)||v||_2, and ||fU||_2 <= gamma_p(u)||yHat||_2, where d = b + r sqrt(r) + p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies every substantive hypothesis from which the combined backward-error statement is formed. In particular, the stored factor bound uses gamma_c(u), while the target concludes the weaker term gamma_{3c}(u).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor choice type with constructors D039 and D040.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents the recompression choice and controls xi and recompression-error semantics.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor choice type with constructors D042 and D043.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents the threshold choice and controls xi and threshold scales.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 2 + 1 is a natural number at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports elaboration of the numeral 3 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 1 + 1 is a natural number at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports numeral elaboration and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 5 + 1 is a natural number at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It only supports elaboration of the numeral 6 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent two-by-two case eliminator for a LocalDef029 choice and a LocalDef030 choice.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs the four-way case split defining xi.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of square real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines products in the combined errors and in the run's factorization and block-rank assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Frobenius norm of a rectangular real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Through D022 it fixes the target's matrix norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor algorithm-choice type with constructors D053 and D054.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The selected constructor determines which factorization execution-evidence type must be inhabited in run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Dependent elimination on LocalDef029, choosing the D040 branch first and the D039 branch second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies the recompression case split used by xi and recompression-error definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of the recompression-choice type LocalDef029.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In the xi table it gives xi = p for threshold D043 and xi = p^2/sqrt(6) for threshold D042.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: The other constructor of the recompression-choice type LocalDef029.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In the xi table it gives xi = 1 for threshold D043 and xi = p for threshold D042.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: Dependent elimination on LocalDef030, choosing the D043 branch first and the D042 branch second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies the threshold case split used by xi and threshold scales.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of the threshold-choice type LocalDef030.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the p or p^2/sqrt(6) branches of xi and the global matrix-norm threshold scale in nested assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: The other constructor of the threshold-choice type LocalDef030.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the 1 or p branches of xi and the local block-norm threshold scale in nested assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: It dispatches on the algorithm choice: constructor D054 requires a nonempty LocalDef059 execution object, while constructor D053 requires a nonempty LocalDef058 execution object.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an admissible-run hypothesis; it does not occur directly in the final formulas but restricts which runs exist.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: A typed execution certificate for a block triangular solve, parameterized by direction, precision u, triangular matrix T, right-hand side, and computed solution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run requires nonempty lower- and upper-solve certificates, indirectly constraining the data used in the backward-error conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef046(m,n) is the type of m by n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies rectangular block-factor types in nested rank and execution assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of the two-way solve-direction type, selecting indices j < i and lower-triangular structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the lower-solve execution model required by run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: The other constructor of the solve-direction type, selecting indices i < j and upper-triangular structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the upper-solve execution model required by run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: Atilde is a threshold approximation of block matrix A when every diagonal block is unchanged and every off-diagonal block is a minimum-rank candidate satisfying D062 at tolerance epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run assumes this for Atilde at admissible parameters; it restricts run existence but Atilde is not present in the final conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines d = b + r sqrt(r) + p as a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run uses gamma_d(u) in its lower- and upper-factor solve-error hypotheses, from which the combined remainder is obtained.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: L and U both admit off-diagonal block factorizations of rank r, and r is no larger than any rank s that works simultaneously for both.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes r a minimal common structural block rank in run; it has no direct occurrence in the final equations except through c and stored assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: A square matrix is two-sided invertible: there exists Ainv with Ainv A = I and A Ainv = I.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run assumes A is invertible and nested solve certificates assume invertible diagonal blocks; the target does not assert invertibility of A plus matrixError.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: One constructor of the algorithm-choice type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects nonempty LocalDef058 factorization evidence in D044.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: The other constructor of the algorithm-choice type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects nonempty LocalDef059 factorization evidence in D044.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the two recompression constructors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements case distinctions on recompression and contributes no extra proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the two threshold constructors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements case distinctions on threshold and contributes no extra proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a solve certificate. It requires the direction-appropriate triangular structure, invertible diagonal blocks, modeled off-diagonal products and their norm bounds, componentwise right-hand-side and product relative errors bounded by gamma_p(u), diagonal matrix errors bounded by gamma_b(u), and the corresponding block substitution equations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact semantics of the lower and upper solve-execution assumptions stored in run, but those certificates are not exposed in the final conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: A factorization-execution certificate type constructed by D067, using compressed off-diagonal updated blocks.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For algorithm constructor D053, run must contain evidence that this execution model is realizable.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: A factorization-execution certificate type constructed by D068, using raw off-diagonal blocks followed by scaled compression.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For algorithm constructor D054, run must contain evidence that this execution model is realizable.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: A two-constructor direction type with constructors D047 and D048.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It distinguishes lower from upper triangular solve semantics in nested run assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent dispatcher on the algorithm choice, selecting the D054 branch first and D053 branch second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements D044's choice of factorization certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: A block candidate has rank parameter k if it is formed from b by k factors X and Y, with X having orthonormal columns, oriented as X Y^T or Y X^T according to block position, and its Frobenius error from A_ij is at most epsilon times either ||A_ij||_F or ||A||_F according to the threshold choice.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the thresholding property assumed of Atilde inside run and does not directly enter the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: The n by n identity matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines two-sided matrix invertibility in D052.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: A block matrix has off-diagonal block rank at most r when every off-diagonal b by b block can be written X Y^T with X and Y of size b by r.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the common-rank assumption on L and U.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: It extracts the b by b block A_ij from a p b by p b matrix using flattened index i b + row.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the block interpretation used throughout the nested structural and execution assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: A wrapper around the primitive algorithm recursor, selecting the D054 branch then the D053 branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs algorithm case analysis only.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: It constructs a LocalDef058 factorization certificate from a recompression-error model, block lower and upper triangularity, modeled rounded updates, equality of diagonal row and column updates, compression certificates for strict off-diagonal updates, diagonal product error models, and lower/upper off-diagonal solve error models.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies one possible algorithm-execution semantics admitted by run; its internal witnesses are not present in the target conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: It constructs a LocalDef059 factorization certificate from a recompression-error model, triangularity, rounded updates, diagonal product error models, raw lower and upper off-diagonal solve models, positive diagonal block norms, and compression of scaled raw blocks.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies the other possible algorithm-execution semantics admitted by run; its internal witnesses are not present in the target conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent dispatcher on the threshold choice, selecting the D043 branch then the D042 branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It chooses local block-norm versus global matrix-norm threshold scales in nested definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent dispatcher on solve direction, selecting D047 then D048.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It chooses lower- versus upper-triangular index and structure conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: It flattens a block index i in Fin p and an intra-block row in Fin b to the index i b + row in Fin(p b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the block decomposition used in all nested block definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: A p by p block matrix L is block lower triangular: L_ij = 0 whenever i < j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required of L in factorization and lower-solve execution evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: A p by p block matrix U is block upper triangular: U_ij = 0 whenever j < i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required of U in factorization and upper-solve execution evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines b + r sqrt(r) as a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its gamma factor bounds block-product rounding errors inside solve certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: For b by r matrices X and Y, it returns X Y^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines low-rank block representations used in structural, thresholding, and compression assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: The all-ones vector of length n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used to express componentwise multiplicative relative errors in solve certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: It returns X Y^T when j < i and Y X^T otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It orients low-rank candidates according to the off-diagonal block position in thresholding.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: The columns of X are orthonormal: for all columns j and k, sum_i X_ij X_ik is 1 if j = k and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains low-rank factors in threshold and compression candidates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: For direction D047 it means j < i; for direction D048 it means i < j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the off-diagonal blocks participating in lower or upper substitution.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a direction and block row i, it is the finite set of block indices j satisfying D079.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the summation set in block triangular substitution equations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: Componentwise vector multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses multiplicative componentwise relative errors in solve certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: It extracts block i, a vector of length b, from a vector of length p b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the block-vector interpretation in solve certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the two algorithm constructors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements algorithm case analysis and adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type of certified compressed approximations of a b by b matrix at tolerance epsilon and scale beta.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its constructor D095 imposes minimum-rank approximation and explicit error conditions in one factorization execution model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: A wrapper around the primitive recursor for the two solve directions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It performs lower/upper direction case analysis only.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: The threshold scale for block A_ik: it is ||A_ik||_F for constructor D043 and ||A||_F for constructor D042.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales nested thresholding and recompression error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef087
dependency_coverage.meaning: It proves that the flattened index i b + row is less than p b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes block-index flattening well typed and has no substantive effect on the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef088
dependency_coverage.meaning: A rounded block-update model: for j < k it introduces products L_ij U_jk plus recompression and product errors; bounds each product error by gamma_c(u)||L_ij||_F||U_jk||_F; bounds componentwise input and product relative errors by gamma_p(u); and defines the rounded update as A_ik with componentwise input error minus the sum of products with componentwise product errors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains intermediate factorization updates inside run's execution evidence but is absent from the final formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef089
dependency_coverage.meaning: A block product model asserting L U = input + error with ||error||_F <= gamma_b(u)||L||_F||U||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It models diagonal block factorization error inside the algorithm certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef090
dependency_coverage.meaning: A right block-solve model asserting (T + error) X = rhs with ||error||_F <= gamma_b(u)||T||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It models one orientation of off-diagonal block solves inside factorization evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef091
dependency_coverage.meaning: A left block-solve model asserting X (T + error) = rhs with ||error||_F <= gamma_b(u)||T||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It models the other orientation of off-diagonal block solves inside factorization evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef092
dependency_coverage.meaning: For recompression constructor D040 every recompression error block is zero. For constructor D039, errors with j < k satisfy ||error_ikj||_F <= epsilon times the threshold scale for A_ik.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines how the recompression choice constrains nested factorization execution; it influences the coefficient xi obtained in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef093
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of rectangular real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines low-rank products used by D075.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef094
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix transpose.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines X Y^T in low-rank block representations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef095
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a compression certificate: it supplies a rank that is minimal among all D101 candidates, an error with compressed = exact + error, and ||error||_F <= epsilon beta.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact compression semantics required by D067.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef096
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the two solve-direction constructors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements direction case analysis and adds no proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef097
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent dispatcher on recompression, selecting D040 then D039.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the two cases in the recompression-error condition D092.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef098
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k in Fin p, it is the finite set of j with j < k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes earlier products in factorization block updates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef099
dependency_coverage.meaning: Entrywise multiplication of two square matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses componentwise relative errors in rounded block updates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef100
dependency_coverage.meaning: The all-ones n by n matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the multiplicative identity pattern for componentwise relative-error matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef101
dependency_coverage.meaning: A rank-k approximation candidate for exact: there exist b by k matrices X and Y with X having orthonormal columns, candidate = X Y^T, and ||candidate-exact||_F <= epsilon beta.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the candidate class whose minimum rank is certified by D095.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires all equalities, remainder properties, nonnegativity statements, and bounds simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It imposes exact functional definitions and the exact perturbed linear-system identity.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It introduces matrixError, then rhsError, then rhsRemainder as dependent witnesses.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin

binders: b, p, and r are implicit natural numbers.

run is an arbitrary inhabitant of LocalDef001(b,p,r), hence a complete run-data package. In particular it contains n = p b dimensional matrices and vectors, choices of algorithm, threshold, and recompression modes, and the assumptions listed below.

The conclusion existentially chooses, in order, a matrix-valued function matrixError(u,epsilon), a vector-valued function rhsError(u,epsilon), and then a real-valued function rhsRemainder(u,epsilon). The third witness may logically be selected after the first two, although the first two are uniquely fixed by required functional equalities.
hypotheses: The run package contains proofs that 0 < b, 0 < p, and r <= b. Thus n = p b is positive, while r may be zero.
It contains an n by n real matrix A, a vector v in R^n, and a two-sided inverse of A.

It contains a threshold choice, a recompression choice, an algorithm choice, an approximation Atilde(epsilon), factors L(u,epsilon) and U(u,epsilon), an intermediate vector yHat(u,epsilon), and a computed vector xHat(u,epsilon).

For every admissible u and epsilon, Atilde has unchanged diagonal b by b blocks and minimum-rank off-diagonal threshold approximations; L and U have minimal common off-diagonal block rank r; and the execution-certificate type selected by the algorithm is nonempty.

Writing c = b + 2 r sqrt(r) + p and xi as in the four-way choice table, the run contains factorError E0 and factorRemainder rhoA such that, for admissible u and epsilon, A + E0 = L U and ||E0||_F <= (xi epsilon + gamma_p(u))||A||_F + gamma_c(u)||L||_F||U||_F + rhoA.

For admissible u and epsilon, rhoA(u,epsilon) >= 0. Globally, rhoA has the explicit local O(u epsilon) property: there exist C >= 0 and delta > 0 such that |rhoA(u,epsilon)| <= C u epsilon whenever 0 < u < epsilon and u,epsilon <= delta.
The run contains lower and upper matrix errors EL and EU and right-hand-side errors fL and fU satisfying, for admissible u and epsilon, (L+EL)yHat = v+fL and (U+EU)xHat = yHat+fU.

Writing d = b + r sqrt(r) + p, the solve errors satisfy ||EL||_F <= gamma_d(u)||L||_F, ||EU||_F <= gamma_d(u)||U||_F, ||fL||_2 <= gamma_p(u)||v||_2, and ||fU||_2 <= gamma_p(u)||yHat||_2 for admissible u and epsilon.
The lower and upper block triangular solve execution-certificate types are nonempty for admissible u and epsilon.
conclusions: The matrix perturbation is fixed for every real u and epsilon by matrixError = factorError + lowerError U + L upperError + lowerError upperError.
The right-hand-side perturbation is fixed for every real u and epsilon by rhsError = lowerRhsError + L upperRhsError + lowerError upperRhsError.
The fixed factorRemainder satisfies the explicit local O(u epsilon) property.
There exists rhsRemainder with the explicit local O(u^2 solveScale) property, where solveScale(u,epsilon) = ||L(u,epsilon)||_F ||U(u,epsilon)||_F ||xHat(u,epsilon)||_2.
For every admissible u and epsilon, factorRemainder(u,epsilon) >= 0 and rhsRemainder(u,epsilon) >= 0.
For every admissible u and epsilon, the exact perturbed system (A + matrixError(u,epsilon)) xHat(u,epsilon) = v + rhsError(u,epsilon) holds.
For every admissible u and epsilon, ||matrixError(u,epsilon)||_F <= (xi epsilon + gamma_p(u))||A||_F + gamma_{3c}(u)||L(u,epsilon)||_F||U(u,epsilon)||_F + factorRemainder(u,epsilon).
For every admissible u and epsilon, ||rhsError(u,epsilon)||_2 <= gamma_p(u)(||v||_2 + ||L(u,epsilon)||_F||U(u,epsilon)||_F||xHat(u,epsilon)||_2) + rhsRemainder(u,epsilon).
mathematical_definitions: c = b + 2 r sqrt(r) + p, with b, p, and r interpreted as real numbers.
gamma_k(u) = k u/(1-k u). Thus gamma_p(u) = p u/(1-p u) and gamma_{3c}(u) = 3 c u/(1-3 c u).
For recompression constructor D040, xi = 1 with threshold constructor D043 and xi = p with D042. For recompression constructor D039, xi = p with D043 and xi = p^2/sqrt(6) with D042.
All matrix products in the displayed perturbations are ordinary matrix-matrix or matrix-vector products.
||A||_F = sqrt(sum_i sum_j A_ij^2) is the Frobenius norm, not an operator norm.
||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2) is the Euclidean vector norm.
matrixError(u,epsilon) = factorError(u,epsilon) + lowerError(u,epsilon) U(u,epsilon) + L(u,epsilon) upperError(u,epsilon) + lowerError(u,epsilon) upperError(u,epsilon).
rhsError(u,epsilon) = lowerRhsError(u,epsilon) + L(u,epsilon) upperRhsError(u,epsilon) + lowerError(u,epsilon) upperRhsError(u,epsilon).
Admissible(c,u,epsilon) means 0 < u < epsilon, epsilon > 0, and 3 c u < 1.
The factor-remainder condition is an explicit local estimate |factorRemainder(u,epsilon)| <= C u epsilon for some C >= 0 and delta > 0 and all 0 < u < epsilon with u,epsilon <= delta.

The right-hand-side-remainder condition is an explicit local estimate |rhsRemainder(u,epsilon)| <= C u^2 solveScale(u,epsilon) for some C >= 0 and delta > 0 whenever 0 < u < epsilon, u,epsilon <= delta, and solveScale(u,epsilon) >= 0.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every fully certified run with positive block size b and block count p, rank parameter r <= b, coefficient matrix A, right-hand side v, computed factors L and U, and computed solution xHat, one can combine the run's factorization and triangular-solve errors into explicit total perturbations Delta A and Delta v. One can also choose a second-order right-hand-side remainder. The fixed factorization remainder is locally O(u epsilon), and the new remainder is locally O(u^2 ||L||_F||U||_F||xHat||_2). For every positive pair 0 < u < epsilon satisfying 3(b+2r sqrt(r)+p)u < 1, both remainders are nonnegative, xHat exactly solves (A+Delta A)xHat = v+Delta v, and the stated Frobenius- and Euclidean-norm bounds hold with xi determined by the two discrete threshold and recompression choices, gamma_p(u), and gamma_{3c}(u).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The outer statement is universal over run. For any b, p, and r for which LocalDef001(b,p,r) is empty, the theorem is vacuously true. Inhabiting run itself forces 0 < b, 0 < p, and r <= b and requires many strong algorithmic and error-model assumptions.

The pointwise perturbed equation, nonnegativity, and norm bounds are implications from admissibility. They impose no condition at parameter pairs failing 0 < u, 0 < epsilon, u < epsilon, or 3 c u < 1.
The functional equalities defining matrixError and rhsError hold for all real u and epsilon, including inadmissible values; only their equations and bounds are restricted to admissible values.
Real division in Lean is totalized at a zero denominator. Under admissibility, however, 1-3 c u is positive; because run forces c >= p > 0, 1-p u is also positive.
The target uses the Frobenius matrix norm, not the spectral or induced operator norm.
The factor remainder is fixed by run. Only rhsRemainder is newly free; matrixError and rhsError are existentially presented but uniquely prescribed by exact equalities.
The asymptotic constants C and radii delta may depend on run and on the chosen remainder, but not on u or epsilon inside their quantified neighborhoods.
The rhs-remainder property only explicitly applies when solveScale >= 0. Here solveScale is a product of Frobenius and Euclidean norms and is therefore mathematically nonnegative.
The proposition does not assert that A + matrixError is invertible, that the perturbed solution is unique, or that xHat is close to the exact solution A^{-1}v.
It gives absolute backward-error bounds. It does not divide by ||A|| or ||v|| and therefore does not state relative backward error.
No forward-error bound, condition-number estimate, probability statement, complexity claim, or claim about behavior outside the packaged execution model is encoded.

Although run carries detailed thresholding, rank-minimality, triangularity, invertibility, and execution-certificate assumptions, the conclusion exposes only the combined perturbation equations, remainder properties, and norm bounds.
The stored factor-error hypothesis uses gamma_c(u), whereas the target's combined matrix bound uses gamma_{3c}(u). The latter is the exact coefficient encoded in the conclusion.
The parameter r may equal zero; no strict positivity assumption on r is encoded.
ambiguities: The mathematical behavior of each two-constructor choice is explicit, but the dossier does not encode human-readable semantic labels for constructors D039/D040, D042/D043, or D053/D054. They can only be identified exactly by constructor ID and branch behavior.
The execution-certificate types precisely constrain admissible runs through their constructors, but no external algorithm name or intended paper terminology is encoded.

The symbols u and epsilon are real parameters with explicit inequalities and bounds; any interpretation as unit roundoff, compression tolerance, or another application-specific quantity is not part of the proposition itself.
